reuses: same 20-byte fade-view template as ecl::TimelineFadeView0Component (layouts\timeline, confirmed live for View0) and ecl::ObstructionFadeView0Component (layouts\alive, 31 live instances); field names copied from there
summary: Per-entity fade state for render view 0, one of the ~13 ecl::*FadeView0/1 sources that bg3.exe+0x18E1E00 handles side by side (it removes the component for entities no longer in its source list). Never alive in the captures; layout from the Windows creator only.

fields.name: TargetValue
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x18F4030 (only rx3 user; ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(.., 0x14)) writes 0 as a 4-byte store (*puVar4 = 0); meaning from the identical creator/system pair of the Timeline sibling (bg3.exe+0x18F6530 / 0x18EB2D0).

fields.name: field_4
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x18F4030 writes 0x40800000 = 4.0 (puVar4[1]). Probably the fade speed, as in the Timeline sibling; no reader found.

fields.name: Immediate
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x18F4030 writes 0 with one 16-bit store covering +8/+9; the Timeline sibling's system copies byte 8 of the request here and, when set, writes TargetValue into CurrentValue at once.

fields.name: field_9
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x18F4030: second byte of the 16-bit zero store at +8; byte-wide in the Timeline sibling's request copy.

fields.name: field_A
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x18F4030 writes 1 as a byte at +10.

fields.name: _PadB
fields.evidence: not written by bg3.exe+0x18F4030; padding before the float at +0xC (live garbage in the siblings)

fields.name: CurrentValue
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x18F4030 writes 0x3f800000 = 1.0 (puVar4[3]); meaning from the Timeline sibling.

fields.name: Active
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x18F4030 writes 1 as a byte at +0x10; meaning from the Timeline sibling.

fields.name: _Pad11
fields.evidence: tail padding to the registry size 20 (alignment 4)

open_questions: field_4 / field_9 / field_A meaning (open in all fade-view siblings).
